target.family: TI C2000 F28003x real-time MCU series
target.core: TMS320C28x 32-bit DSP @ 120 MHz (FPU32 + TMU + VCRC) + CLA @ 120 MHz

clock.external: crystal oscillator or external clock input supported

gpio.warning: Do NOT mux GPIO35-38 to digital I/O; JTAG becomes permanently unusable.

gpio_registers_word_addresses.note: C28x word addressing: every address below is a 16-bit WORD address (linker .cmd, map file, DSS readWord, XARn all agree). 32-bit registers span two words. Verified on target 2026-10-17 (diag15 breakpoint-diff trace). See harness/docs/40 and ADR 0002.
gpio_registers_word_addresses.pud_semantics: GPxPUD bit 1 = pull-up DISABLED; reset default all 1 (C2000 internal pull-ups are off by default; unused pins float and pick up noise)
gpio_registers_word_addresses.driverlib_verdict: driverlib GPIO addressing verified CORRECT: GPIO_writePin stores pinMask to GPASET(0x7F02)/GPACLEAR(0x7F04); on-target final state matches design (LED4 on, LED5 off, SCIA pins muxed). Do NOT bypass driverlib.

facts: map file size column is in words
DSS memory.readWord(0, addr) reads ONE 16-bit word at word address addr
CHAR_BIT == 16 (a C byte is a 16-bit word)
address_model.evidence: linker .cmd FLASH_BANK0_SEC4 origin 0x84000 == map .const@0x84000; led_hw_channels (16 bytes) map size 0x08 = 8 words; disassembly MOVL XAR4,#0x084432; readWord(0,0x84432)=0x0014 (pin 20 low half)

startup_order.note: Hard constraint verified 2026-10-17 (ADR 0003, docs/40 '固件启动顺序'). Violating it kills the firmware milliseconds after start with no console output and no LED activity.
sequence: 0) .TI.ramfunc relocation (memcpy LOAD=FLASH_BANK0_SEC1 -> RUN=RAMLS0 0x8000) + word-by-word ready check
0b) SysCtl_disableWatchdog() (debugger loads can bypass code_start/wd_disable and land directly in main)
0c) Interrupt_initModule() + Interrupt_initVectorTable() (with PIE disabled, traps vector from boot ROM whose ITRAP handler enables the watchdog and resets)
ramfunc_facts: driverlib SysCtl_delay() is emitted as inline assembly into section .TI.ramfunc
flash linker cmd splits it: LOAD = FLASH_BANK0_SEC1, RUN = RAMLS0 (0x8000)
the C runtime (_c_int00) does NOT copy LOAD->RUN sections - an explicit memcpy is mandatory before any SysCtl_* call
symptom of omission: SysCtl_setClock -> SysCtl_delay branches into empty RAMLS0, executes 0x0000, ITRAP -> boot ROM watchdog reset; diagnostic clue: PC parks at board_clock_init, RESC=0

loadti.note: loadti loads via memory.loadProgram(file, argvArgs) and therefore requires the image to define __c_args__; DSS memory.loadProgram(file) (HIL path) does not. Verified 2026-10-17 (ADR 0004).
loadti.linker_flag: --args=0x200 (in projects/*/Makefile LDFLAGS; defines __c_args__, .args section in RAM)
loadti.failure_mode: SEVERE: __c_args__ not defined ... Error code #4011, load failed (affects ccs.ps1 program only)
loadti.self_check: map file: __c_args__ = abs ffffffff means undefined

peripheral_clock_gates.note: F28003x peripheral clocks are OFF at reset (CPUSYS PCLKCRn bits). Accessing a gated peripheral works, but every REGISTER WRITE to it is silently dropped - no error, no bus fault, readback keeps 0x0000. C28x word addressing: driverlib adds the byte-style offset to the word base directly (CPUSYS_BASE 0x5D300).
peripheral_clock_gates.PCLKCR0: 0x5D322 (bit 3 = CPUTIMER0 clock; measured live value 0x001000039 with the app running)
peripheral_clock_gates.sci_failure_mode: PCLKCR7.SCIA=0 -> SCI_setConfig/SCI_enableModule writes vanish: CTL1 stays 0x0000 (want 0x000B RXENA|TXENA|SWRESET), LBAUD stays 0x0000 (want 0x1F = 30MHz/(115200*8)-1), TX pin silent. A/B proven 2026-10-17 (diag17: write before/after setting the bit; diag18: forced boot of the unfixed image -> CTL1=0x0, 0 bytes on both XDS110 COM ports)
peripheral_clock_gates.firmware_rule: Any project driving a peripheral must call SysCtl_enablePeripheral(SYSCTL_PERIPH_CLK_x) BEFORE touching that peripheral. TI's own f28003x InitSysCtrl() (device_support/f28003x/common/source/f28003x_sysctrl.c:186) sets SCI_A for exactly this reason; a driverlib-only port that skips it loses all console output.
peripheral_clock_gates.hil_guard: hil_test.js H3 reads word 0x5D330 and fails with H3-sciclk if bit 0 is clear
peripheral_clock_gates.adr: harness/docs/adr/0005-外设时钟门控与定时器时基.md

cputimer.timebase: CPUTIMER0 decrements at SYSCLK (120MHz), NOT at LSPCLK/SYSCLK-4, with TPR=0 - measured halt-free 2026-10-17: PRD=30000 produced a 51.4ms mean LED flip interval (200 ticks x 257us). A period of SYSCLK/tick_hz is therefore correct; the SYSCLK/4 assumption made the chaser run 4x fast.
cputimer.emulation_mode: TCR bits 10-8 (ICEM) reset to 0 = stop at zero on halt. board_timer_init() now sets CPUTIMER_EMULATIONMODE_RUNFREE (0x0800).
cputimer.halt_distortion: TIF (TCR bit 15) is a single flag, so all overflows produced while the core is halted collapse into ONE increment when a polled main loop resumes. Any cadence measured through halt/read cycles is stretched by the halt duty (2026-10-17: 426ms reported for the 200ms step at ~50% halt duty). Measure timing halt-free (memory peeks while the core runs).
cputimer.adr: harness/docs/adr/0005-外设时钟门控与定时器时基.md

boot_mode.note: F28003x has no -TRST pin: the boot ROM reads RESC bit 31 (DCON = debugger connected) to choose Emulation Boot over Stand-Alone Boot. With a probe attached, an invalid emulation key sends the ROM to Wait/SCI-boot instead of jumping to flash 0x80000, so a debugger-issued reset NEVER hands off to the flashed application.
boot_mode.resc: word 0x5D380 (CPUSYS_BASE 0x5D300 + SYSCTL_O_RESC 0x80; driverlib/inc/hw_sysctl.h:126). Bit decode (hw_sysctl.h:970-979): 0x1 POR, 0x2 XRSn, 0x4 WDRSn, 0x8 NMIWDRSn, 0x20 HWBISTn, 0x100 SCCRESETn, 0x40000000 XRSn pin status, 0x80000000 DCON
boot_mode.observed: diag17/diag20 (2026-10-17): after target.reset() PC parks at 0x3FB8B9 (boot ROM SCI wait) and stays there for >5s with RESC=0xC0000004 (WDRSn + XRSn high + DCON); LED halt-free transitions = 0. Forcing PC=0x80000 (entry word 0x48 = LCR) boots the application immediately.
boot_mode.harness_consequence: hil_test.js H6 starts the app with PC = code_start + runAsynch + disconnect, which is the documented stand-alone-equivalent start. Autonomous Stand-Alone boot (POR with no probe) is NOT covered by any automated gate - it needs a human power cycle.
boot_mode.adr: harness/docs/adr/0006-仿真启动模式与H6冷启动.md
sources: TI C2000 TRM boot chapters (Emulation Boot vs Stand-Alone Boot, emulation key 0x5A)
e2e.ti.com threads 756676 / 501033 (same park after CCS CPU reset, works after power cycle)

hil_evidence.note: Runtime HIL results are deliberately NOT stored in this card. The card is board facts; a run result is project state, and two copies drift (the card claimed status=pass while state.json said unavailable). Truth = projects/<proj>/state.json hil block (contract harness/schemas/state.schema.json, written by run-hil.ps1) plus the evidence records. Durable method conclusions belong to the ADRs and to cputimer/boot_mode above, not here.
